messages:
Maria L: Heads-up: local runs ignoring `--quantize` flag for 4-bit experiments. Did a quick bring-up and metrics are all float32.
Kevin T: repro steps?
Maria L: `./bin/evalharness run --config configs/mini.yaml --quantize=4bit` -> still runs fp16. Also tried `EVAL_QUANT=4bit ./bin/evalharness ...`
Raj P: I saw similar in CI for the new llama-65b q4 run yesterday :bug:
Sophie C: which parser path? argparse? click?
Maria L: It's click, but the runner has a `--skip-config` shortcut that merges env vars after parsing — looks like merge order is wrong.
Kevin T: can you paste stack/args dump?
Maria L: ```
args: {'config': 'configs/mini.yaml', 'quantize': None}
env: EVAL_QUANT=4bit
config file: quantize: 4bit
``` 
Kevin T: ah, `quantize` defaults to None and config loader only applies if arg is falsy, but click treats empty string weirdly. Bug: booly check blocks override.
Raj P: CI job `ci/quicklocal` has a test that asserts quantize in metadata, but it's mocking CLI flags not env. PR for that test added in #2345
Maria L: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/eval-harness/pull/2345
devex-bot: linked ci job failed: ci/quicklocal (see https://ci.redwood.ai/quicklocal/987) :eyes:
Sophie C: Proposal: add explicit CLI validation step before run: if quantize not in [None,'4bit','8bit','fp16'] -> fail with exit code 2. Also add `--force-config-override` flag.
Kevin T: Also fix merge order: apply env vars last so they override config + flags? Hmm probably flags should win, then env, then config.
Maria L: Agreed: precedence flags > env > config. I'll open a small PR to change merge_order and add unit tests.
Raj P: I'll patch CI to test both flag and env precedence. Assigning to @Maria L and @Raj P :thumbsup:
Maria L: ETA EOD today, will add changelog note and update docs `docs/local_run.md` about precedence.
Sophie C: Add a CLI lint step in devex pre-commit maybe.
Maria L: Thanks all :pray:
